title: Cloud save version committed
description: A new cloud save version was uploaded and became the current version of its slot. The subject is the slot.

slot_id.description: The slot the version was committed against.

user_id.description: The account that owns the slot.

game_id.description: The game the slot belongs to.

slot.description: The slot slug the user chose.

version.description: The new current version number for the slot, monotonically increasing.

version_id.description: The stored version. Also the object storage key suffix.

size_bytes.description: How large the committed version is, in bytes.
